articles.summary: Arteris network-on-chip IP supports scalable high-performance data movement in Speedata’s purpose-built Analytics Processing Unit for large-scale data analytics workloads.
articles.title: Arteris Deployed by Speedata for Data Center Compute

articles.summary: This Semiconductor Engineering article examines how SoC integration has become a major bottleneck as designs scale in complexity, with growing numbers of IP blocks, registers, and hardware/software interfaces.
articles.title: Semiconductor Engineering: Avoid The Hidden Bottleneck Of Integration At Scale

articles.summary: Arteris hardware security assurance products are being extended across the Arm CPU IP portfolio, building on five years of collaboration.
articles.title: Arteris Expands Partnership with Arm to Accelerate Semiconductor Cybersecurity

articles.summary: This article explains why building successful AI chiplet architectures requires more than high-speed die-to-die connectivity. It explores how efficient data movement, protocol selection, coherency, and intelligent NoC architecture are critical to maximizing performance, scalability, and energy efficiency in next-generation AI systems.
articles.title: The AI Journal: Making chiplets work for AI requires more than connectivity

articles.summary: As software-defined vehicles reshape the automotive industry, collaborative innovation is becoming essential to developing secure, scalable computing platforms. Learn how Arteris is contributing to the European RIGOLETTO project, helping advance next-generation automotive architectures through expertise in Network-on-Chip technology, RISC-V integration, and high-performance semiconductor design.
articles.title: Advancing Europe’s Automotive Innovation Ecosystem: Arteris Continues Its Work in the RIGOLETTO Project

articles.summary: Arteris collaborates with IC-Link by imec, imec’s design and manufacturing service provider for ASICs and silicon photonics. Arteris NoC IP will be deployed as part of the ongoing effort to accelerate and simplify the development of next-generation AI and high-performance computing chiplets and application specific integrated circuits.
articles.title: Arteris Announces Collaboration with IC-Link by imec to Accelerate Next-Gen AI and HPC Silicon
